name: Bucketforms Lite
author: chadcombinator

sections.description:
Bucketforms Lite is the modern conversational form builder for WordPress. Say goodbye to boring, endless vertical forms and expensive recurring SaaS subscriptions.

With Bucketforms Lite, you can build engaging, one-question-at-a-time forms that guide respondents smoothly through your questions with responsive 50/50 split layouts, fluid animations, and keyboard navigation.

All form submission data stays 100% self-hosted on your own WordPress site, giving you complete data privacy and ownership with zero artificial submission caps or locked leads.

✨ Key Features

  • Conversational 50/50 Split Runner: Questions are presented one-at-a-time with intuitive keyboard shortcuts (Enter / Tab). On desktop, respondents enjoy a split layout; on mobile, it smoothly adapts to a clean fullscreen experience.
  • 15 Free Field Types: Short Text, Long Text, Multiple Choice, Star Rating, Opinion Scale (1–10), Yes/No Boolean, Statement, Number, Email, Phone, Date Picker, Website URL, Legal Agreement / Terms, Document / File Upload, and Digital Signature Pad.
  • Smart Conditional Logic (Branching): Create personalized questionnaire paths by showing or jumping to specific steps based on respondent choices.
  • Score & Quiz Calculations: Real-time formula scoring, points calculation, and dynamic outcome brackets for quizzes, assessments, and lead qualification.
  • Standalone Landing Pages: Every form gets an instant, distraction-free landing page at /bf/{slug} with zero theme chrome or distractions.
  • Page Builder Integrations: Native Gutenberg Block (bucketforms/form-embed) and Elementor widget, plus standard WordPress shortcodes ([bucketform id="123"]).
  • Submissions Viewer & CSV Export: View detailed respondent answers, timestamps, and step completions with one-click clean UTF-8 CSV exports. Zero locked leads or submission limits.
  • GDPR & Privacy Compliant: Integrates directly with WordPress Core Privacy Tools (Export Personal Data & Erase Personal Data) with customizable data retention purge schedules.

🎨 Design Studio & Presets

  • 12 Curated Visual Presets: Ocean (default), Aurora, Sunset, Midnight, Emerald, Minimal, Citrus, Berry, Mint, Lavender, Crimson, and Cyber.
  • Ambient wave color animations.
  • Custom background images directly from your WordPress Media Library.
  • Light and Dark theme modes.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the bucketforms-lite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP file via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin in your WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Bucketforms in your admin menu to create your first interactive form.
  4. Embed your form onto any page or post using the Bucketform Gutenberg block, Elementor widget, shortcode [bucketform id="YOUR_FORM_ID"], or view the standalone page at /bf/YOUR-SLUG.
sections.faq:
Do I need a third-party account to use Bucketforms Lite?

No. Bucketforms Lite is 100% self-hosted on your own WordPress site and database. You own all your data.

Are file uploads and digital signatures free?

Yes! All 15 field types—including Document/File Uploads and Digital Signature Pads—are 100% free and unlocked.

Are there any limits on forms or submissions in Lite?

No. Bucketforms Lite does not cap your forms or lock your submissions. You can create as many forms and collect as many submissions as your server can handle.

Is Bucketforms Lite compatible with Gutenberg and Elementor?

Yes. Bucketforms Lite includes a dedicated Gutenberg block and an Elementor widget for instant embedding. You can also use the shortcode [bucketform id="..."] anywhere.

What is the standalone form URL?

Every published form can be accessed directly without theme headers/footers via /bf/{slug}, ideal for paid ad funnels and social media bio links.

What happens if someone submits a form on mobile?

The responsive form runner automatically switches to an optimized fullscreen experience on mobile devices with touch-friendly controls and bottom navigation.

Can I use my Bucketforms Pro license on multiple websites?

Yes! Every Bucketforms Pro license key is valid for up to 10 WordPress websites. You can activate it across your own sites and client installations directly from your WordPress admin.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • Rebranded to Bucketforms Lite.
  • Updated standalone form route to /bf/{slug}.
  • Added native Gutenberg block (bucketforms/form-embed) and Elementor widget.
  • Completely removed submission lock restrictions and form creation limits.
  • Fully decoupled Pro extensions (Google Sheets sync, outbound webhooks, automatic license updates) into modular Bucketforms Pro add-on.
  • Script and stylesheet asset loading optimization with full REST API hardening.
  • WordPress Core GDPR Export and Erase personal data tool support.
  • Ocean background preset set as default with zero external image dependencies.
